messages.author: 891813bfbff9f848
messages.subject: Merge proposal to allow free_x and free_y on space argument in facet_grid
parts:
As requested by Hadley, I have created a thread here for discussion.
I already received some comments, which I have already incorporated in
a new version.

I have added a section to NEWS and added an example to the
documentation (which by the way already stated that free_x and free_y
were valid options).

I also took the time to create a new branch which contains my patch.
That can be found here:
https://github.com/wligtenberg/ggplot2/tree/facet_grid_space_freex
And I have created a pull request as requested.

Kind regards,

Willem

PS: My first github experience, so a learning experience for me. But I
like it very much!

messages.author: 891813bfbff9f848
messages.subject: Re: Merge proposal to allow free_x and free_y on space argument in facet_grid
parts:
Hadley asked me to do the following:
the last thing to do is to update your checkout and then rebase this
branch so I can cleanly include it.

So I did the following:
git checkout master
git pull
git rebase facet_grid_space_freex (which is my branch name)
this gave a conflict which I resolved manually.
Then I did git rebase --continue
But now all changes have been applied to my master branch. So I think
I did something wrong.
Or if I didn't how should I proceed?

Thanks in advance,

Willem
